mil7.3.2:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, padumassa tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.3.2:1.2: Yathā mahārāja padumaṃ udake jātaṃ udake saṃvaddhaṃ anupalittaṃ udakena,
mil7.3.2:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena kule gaṇe lābhe yase sakkāre sammānanāya paribhogapaccayesu ca sabbattha anupalittena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.3.2:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja padumassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.3.2:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja padumaṃ udakā accuggamma ṭhāti,
mil7.3.2:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena sabbalokaṃ abhibhavitvā accuggamma lokuttaradhamme ṭhātabbaṃ.
mil7.3.2:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja padumassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.3.2:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja padumaṃ appamattakena pi anilena eritaṃ calati,
mil7.3.2:3.2: evameva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena appamattakesu pi kilesesu saññamo karaṇīyo, bhayadassāvinā viharitabbaṃ.
mil7.3.2:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja padumassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.3.2:3.4: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena: Aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesūti.
